title: Bola de Nieve Navideña Ultrarrealista con Personaje en Traje de Santa Personalizado
prompt:
(Scene & Moment)
An ultra-realistic photograph of a quiet, sacred Christmas night.
A beautiful glass snow globe placed on a tabletop. Inside, snow and light particles slowly fall and swirl, shining fantastically.

(Glass Dome & Base: Premium Quality)
A crystal glass sphere based on a perfect orb shape, arranged to reflect the character's atmosphere from the reference image.
Depict the glass thickness, light refraction through internal liquid (water), and surrounding light reflections on the surface at photographic realism.
The base is made of luxurious, calm material that doesn't break the fantastical mood.

Deeply analyze the character's identity from the reference image (costume design features, color scheme, decorative motifs, atmosphere), and envision:
"The incident this character would most likely cause on the limited day of Christmas"
or "The miracle most characteristic of this character"

Capture the exact moment this is happening and seal it inside the dome.
Give this moment a title and display it in English with fantastical lighting.

(Internal Element 1: Character & Customized Santa Costume)
The character is recreated as an ultra-detailed figure, wearing not just red Santa clothes, but a "custom-made Santa costume" that strongly reflects design elements from the original reference.
Original dress frills, ribbons, armor parts, and specific patterns are fused into the Santa outfit design. Color scheme is based on red and white while incorporating the character's signature colors.

(Internal Element 2: Style-Reflected Props)
Christmas items around the character (tree, present boxes, small houses) are not generic designs but extravagantly arranged to match the reference character's worldview and motifs.

(Internal Element 3: Other Characters)
If other characters appear in the reference image besides the main one, dress them in reindeer costumes arranged to match the atmosphere and place them accordingly.

(Internal Element 4: Hidden Objects)
Something with Christmas arrangement that is characteristic and evocative of features from the reference image.

(Floating Elements & Light)
Not limited to ordinary snow - luminous elements fitting the internal worldview float magically.
Warm, fantastical lighting as if the dome interior is self-illuminating.

(Background & Mood: Complete Unity)
The background fully integrates with the dome's worldview.
Create a quiet atmosphere with lights turned off and everything settled for sleep, making the dome stand out.
Overall dark, but Christmas illumination (warm-toned bokeh, flickering candles) very faintly blends behind the dome.
The entire photograph is filled with a dark, fantastical, breathtakingly beautiful Christmas mood.

(Photography Style)
Emotional close-up with macro lens.
Very shallow depth of field, with focus on the character inside the dome and floating light particles.

(Projected Optical Phenomenon)
Light from inside the snow globe is refracted through the glass and internal liquid, projecting as faint, imperfect light patterns on the table surface.
Patterns appear circular, geometric, or organic, but maintain ambiguity without definitively resembling magic circles or symbols.
Subtly flickers in sync with snow and particle movement.
Light is not a luminous source but a secondary phenomenon, kept at an intensity level that is "noticeable when you look closely" in the dark environment.
